property_summary: For any admissible input, a successful batch transfer via c.transfer must return true (it returns true only when the whole loop's transferFrom calls succeed); the mutant returns false after the identical successful execution, so the fuzz test asserts the return value is true and fails on the mutant for the fuzzer-found inputs.
change_summary: Replace 'return true;' with 'return false;' so the function returns false after a successful batch transfer.
